stem.text: The enzyme $\alpha$-amylase hydrolyses amylopectin but it is not able to hydrolyse some of its glycosidic bonds.

items: It is not able to hydrolyse the last bond of a chain.
It is not able to hydrolyse the bonds in a chain of three units attached by a 1,6 glycosidic bond to another chain.

stem.text: Which glycosidic bond can be hydrolysed by $\alpha$-amylase?

stem.alt: Chain of linked six-membered ring units with labelled bonds A, B, C and D
